verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a home and business phone service, and outbound call/message webhooks are a fair ask for business telephony, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents registrable HTTP callbacks or any developer API, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missed-call alerts, voicemail-to-email and in-app call history are adjacent notification features, not webhooks a programmatic consumer can receive.
